author: Logos V
title: Logos V: [Analysis] Calculate pre_ASW_batch on Human Heart
abstract: This is an analysis-only submission to quantify the initial batch effect severity. It calculates the Average Silhouette Width on batch labels (pre_ASW_batch) in the pre-integration PCA space. This value will serve as the first data point for a new research project on data-driven hyperparameter tuning.

original_submission.content:
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy.sparse import issparse
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
import numpy as np

def _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, target_sum=1e4):
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=target_sum, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

def _pca_array(X, n_comps=50, random_state=0):
    Xd = X.A if issparse(X) else X
    ad_tmp = ad.AnnData(Xd)
    sc.pp.pca(ad_tmp, n_comps=n_comps, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=random_state)
    return ad_tmp.obsm['X_pca']

# This is an analysis function and will not be scored.
def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # This function is required but will be ignored due to the presence of test().
    return adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    """
    Calculates and prints the pre-integration ASW_batch score.
    """
    print("--- Starting pre_ASW_batch Calculation ---")
    
    # 1. Standard preprocessing
    _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, 1e4)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    hv = adata.var['highly_variable'].to_numpy()

    Xh = adata.X[:, hv]
    Xd = (Xh.A if issparse(Xh) else Xh).astype(np.float32, copy=False)

    # 2. Generate PCA representation
    n_pcs_graph = 50
    Zg = _pca_array(Xd, n_comps=n_pcs_graph, random_state=0)
    print(f"PCA representation Zg created with shape: {Zg.shape}")

    # 3. Calculate ASW_batch
    batch_labels = adata.obs['batch'].values
    pre_asw_batch = silhouette_score(Zg, batch_labels)
    
    print(f"\n--- ANALYSIS COMPLETE ---")
    print(f"Pre-integration ASW_batch (pre_ASW_batch) score: {pre_asw_batch:.6f}")
    
    return "Analysis finished."
